findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "dns-lookup" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto-price, fx-rates, defi-tvl, buy_research_brief, url-meta, buy_rea_report, buy_surface_report, summarize, seo-audit, perk_search · Private data: crypto-price, fx-rates, defi-tvl, dns-lookup, crypto-hash, time-convert, diligence-pack, buy_research_brief, buy_data_clean, buy_code_review, url-meta, csv-json, regex, random, onchain-balance, diff, buy_rea_report, buy_surface_report, translate, summarize, entities, keywords, seo-audit · Public sink: fx-rates, dns-lookup · Destructive: buy_code_review, lab_loop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto-price, fx-rates, defi-tvl, buy_research_brief, url-meta, buy_rea_report, buy_surface_report, summarize, seo-audit, perk_search · Private data: crypto-price, fx-rates, defi-tvl, dns-lookup, crypto-hash, time-convert, diligence-pack, buy_research_brief, buy_data_clean, buy_code_review, url-meta, csv-json, regex, random, onchain-balance, diff, buy_rea_report, buy_surface_report, translate, summarize, entities, keywords, seo-audit · Public sink: fx-rates, dns-lookup · Destructive: buy_code_review, lab_loop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
